description: Update fields on an existing lead. Only provided fields will be changed. Do NOT update the updated_at field. To RELEASE a lead a human took over, send human_takeover=false. To record that the person asked us to stop, prefer the opt_out tool/endpoint over setting takeover_source here — a takeover_source label is per-lead and anyone can overwrite it, whereas an opt-out must also be recorded person-level.

human_takeover.description: Whether a human owns this conversation. true fences the lead from ALL automated outbound; false RELEASES it back to the agent. This is a mute as well as a consent fence.

id.description: UUID of the lead to update

pipeline_stage.description: Name of the pipeline stage to move the lead to (not a UUID)

takeover_source.description: WHO raised the fence that is currently in effect: 'user' (someone on your side), 'worker' (this product's automation), 'opt_out' (the person asked us to stop). This is a LABEL and gates nothing here — human_takeover is the field that fences. SEND IT WHENEVER YOU SET human_takeover=true: omit it and the raise is attributed to 'user', because an API key is not this product's automation and we cannot tell your human from your agent. Releasing (human_takeover=false) clears it, so a later re-raise is attributed to whoever raised it THEN, not to whoever raised it before.

name: update_lead
